title: Scorching Mirage
body:
Syntax: perform scorching mirage <target>

Description: A Scorch Release attack that strikes one target. Blindness reduces the target's accuracy.  Requires Scorch Release and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 203-235. 45% chance to inflict blinded. Unlocks at level 45. Costs 42 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 14 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
